milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close enough to the orange wall banner (placed at ~7,~2,~12 on the back wall of the oak shelter) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. Target is set to the banner's spawn-relative coordinates, max_distance=16 allows seeing it from the doorway, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at it.
